title: Deeply nested CSS overflows multiple AST traversal operations
prompt: Valid deeply nested stylesheets fail with 'Maximum call stack size exceeded' during normal AST operations. A stylesheet consisting of 'a{' repeated 6000 times, then 'color:red', then 6000 closing braces should round-trip through parsing/stringification, cloning and the toJSON/fromJSON APIs, and walking it should visit all 6001 nodes. A normal declaration plugin must also be able to change the innermost value without overflowing. Fix the supported traversal paths consistently while preserving ordinary node order, metadata, custom properties with toJSON methods, subclass overrides and visitor revisit semantics. Add regression coverage; changing global runtime stack limits is not an acceptable repair.

hardness_evidence.criterion: at least 20 meaningful changed production lines across at least two functions
families: structured JSON roundtrip and custom serialization
plugin visitor passes and subclass traversal overrides
